resources.string: Capsule is an application to help you run other applications in an isolated profile. It does so by making use of the Work Profile feature of Android. Click "Next", and we will provide you with more information about Capsule, and guide you through the setup process. We suggest that you read through all of the following pages carefully.

By default, Capsule will not ask for any individual permissions. However, once you proceed with the setup process, Capsule will try to set up a Work Profile and hence become the profile manager of said profile. This will grant Capsule an extensive list of permissions inside the profile, comparable to that of a Device Admin, albeit confined to the profile. Being the profile manager is necessary for most of Capsule's functionality. Some advanced features of Capsule may require more permissions outside the Work Profile. When needed, Capsule will ask for those permissions separately when you enable the corresponding features.

Capsule is developed and tested on AOSP-like Android derivatives. This includes AOSP (Android Open Source Project), Google Android (on Pixels), and most AOSP-based open-source custom ROMs such as LineageOS. If your phone is running one of the Android derivatives listed above, then congratulations! Capsule is probably going to work correctly on your device. Some device vendors introduce very invasive customizations into the Android code base, resulting in conflicts, incompatibility and unexpected behavior. Some custom ROMs can also introduce compatibility-breaking changes, but generally these are rarer occurrences compared to phone vendor-introduced incompatibilities. Capsule is merely an interface into the Work Profile feature provided by the system. If the feature provided by the system is broken or non-standard, Capsule could not magically resolve the issue on its own. If you are currently using a vendor-modified Android version that is known to break Work Profiles, you have been warned. You may proceed anyway, but there is no guarantee that Capsule would behave correctly under these circumstances.

We are now ready to set up Capsule for you. If your device is running Android 7 or lower, please first ensure that your device is not in Do Not Disturb mode, because you will need to click on a notification later to finalize the setup process.\n\nWhen you are ready, click on \"Next\" to begin the setup process.
We are trying to initialize Work Profile and set up Capsule on your device.

We were unable to set up Capsule.

If this device already has a work profile from Capsule or another management app, remove it in Settings before trying again. On custom ROMs, setup can also fail when the system provisioning role holder or related setup components are missing. Tap Copy details to collect device and provisioning-handler information. Include it, and a provisioning logcat if available, when reporting the problem.

Tap OK to exit.

You should now be seeing a notification from Capsule. Please click on that notification to finish the setup process. If you do not see the notification, make sure your device is not in Do Not Disturb mode and try pulling down the notification center. To reset Capsule and start over, you can clear the data of Capsule in Settings.

Manipulating apps that are hidden from the list could cause crashes and all sorts of unexpected behavior. However, this feature can be useful when faulty vendor-customized ROMs does not enable all necessary system apps in work profile by default. If you continue, you are on your own.

When enabled, you\'ll be able to browse / view / pick / copy files in Capsule from main profile and vice-versa, ONLY through Documents UI (named Files or Documents on your launcher) or apps with Documents UI support (they only gain temporary access to files you choose in Documents UI), while still retaining the filesystem isolation.
Lets apps request files from the other profile through Android\'s system pickers. Access is limited to files you choose and is off by default.
Deny access from main profile to contacts inside work profile.

Enable a fake NFC payment service in the main profile, so that the \"contactless payments\" option under Settings - NFC becomes enabled to allow you to choose a payment app inside the work profile. This works around an Android bug that makes it impossible to select a payment app inside the work profile if none is available in the main profile.
When the screen is locked, automatically freeze apps launched from \"Unfreeze & Launch Shortcut\".

Do NOT freeze foreground apps (with visible activity) when you lock your screen. This can be useful for apps like music players, but you\'ll need to manually freeze them through \"Batch Freeze Shortcut\" afterwards.

Capsule needs Usage Stats permission to do this. Please enable the permission for BOTH OF THE TWO Capsule apps shown in the dialog after you press \"Ok\". Failing to do so will cause this feature to not work properly.
Capsule needs access to All Files for File Shuttle. Please enable the permission for BOTH OF THE TWO (Personal / Work) Capsule apps shown in the dialog after you press \"Ok\".

Capsule needs to Draw over Other Apps in order for File Shuttle to function correctly. Please enable the permission for BOTH OF THE TWO (Personal / Work) Capsule apps shown in the dialog after you press \"Ok\". This permission is used to start File Shuttle services in the background.
Cloning non-system apps to another profile is currently not possible on MIUI. Please clone your system\'s app store (e.g. Play Store) into the other profile and then install apps from there.
